mediaWork.title: Proof: A True Crime Podcast
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Case-per-season investigative reporting into potential wrongful convictions.
mediaWork.summaryNotes: Hosted by attorney Susan Simpson (Undisclosed) and investigative producer Jacinda Davis. Season 1 ("A Murder at the Warehouse" / Brian Bowling case) uncovered evidence that directly contributed to the December 2022 exonerations of Lee Clark and Joshua Cain Storey after 25 years in prison; subsequent seasons investigate additional disputed convictions.
mediaWork.availabilityNotes: Apple Podcasts · Public RSS feed verified · ~103 episodes on Apple Podcasts
